name: Kihoku (Ehime, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kihoku town emblem in green and blue: a green ring with blue stylised feathers and a small ring.
history: Municipal flag of Kihoku, a town in Ehime Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 2005.

features.role: Kihoku town emblem — a green ring with blue stylised feathers and a small ring
